translation_snapshot.source:
Calls forth a powerful beam of lightning doing %0.2f to %0.2f lightning damage (%0.2f average).
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
召唤一股强烈的闪电束造成 %0.2f 至 %0.2f 闪电伤害（平均 %0.2f）。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: You cannot use Precision without dual wielding!
translation_snapshot.target: 你只有在双持状态下才能使用弱点打击！

translation_snapshot.source: Saps 30%% of the target's speed (increasing yours by the same amount) and inflicts %0.2f temporal damage for three turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 降低目标 30%% 速度，增加你等量的速度，并在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。

translation_snapshot.source:
Reach through the collective psionic gestalt of the yeeks, the Way, to call for immediate help.
		Summons up to 3 yeek mindslayers to your side for 6 turns.
		All their primary stats will be set to %d (based on your Willpower and Talent Level).
		Your increased damage, damage penetration, and many other stats will be inherited.
translation_snapshot.target:
通过夺心魔的集体灵能格式塔——维网——寻求紧急援助。
		在你身边召唤最多 3 名夺心魔心灵杀手，持续 6 回合。
		他们的所有主要属性将设为 %d （数值随你的意志和技能等级提高）。
		他们会继承你的伤害加成、伤害穿透及许多其他属性。

translation_snapshot.source:
Your mind becomes more attuned to the Way, and is shielded from outside effects.
		Increase confusion and silence immunities by %d%% and Mental Save by %d.
translation_snapshot.target:
你的心智与维网更加协调，并得到保护，不受外界影响。
		混乱和沉默免疫提高 %d%%， 精神豁免提高 %d 点。

translation_snapshot.source:
Activate some of your inner magic, using it to power your abilities.  For the next %d turns all active talents will be used without resource cost.
		Your resources must still be high enough to initially power the talent and failure rates (etc.) still apply.
translation_snapshot.target:
激活你的一部分内在魔力，用它来驱动你的能力。在接下来 %d 回合中，所有主动技能的使用都不消耗资源。
		你的资源仍须足以启动技能，失败率等仍照常生效。

translation_snapshot.source:
Orcs have been the prey of the other races for thousands of years, with or without justification. They have learnt to withstand things that would break weaker races.
		When your life goes below 50%% your sheer determination cleanses you of %d mental debuff(s) based on talent level and Willpower.  This can only happen once every %d turns.
		Also increases physical save by %d.
translation_snapshot.target:
其他种族对兽人的猎杀持续了上千年，不管是否正义。你们已经学会忍受那些会摧毁弱小种族的灾难。
		当你的生命值降低到 50%% 以下，你强大的意志移除你身上最多 %d 个精神负面效果（基于技能等级和意志）。该效果每 %d 回合最多触发一次。
		额外增加 %d 物理豁免。
